# F8 contract: `run --mode cycle` -- one cycle-accurate engine alone, from
# reset (no QEMU, no --resume-from-qemu), transparent passthrough. Layers:
#
#   1. run-test (unit, fast): resolve_accurate_engine's selection branches
#      (default-sole / explicit / ambiguous / missing / wrong-kind) + the F7
#      passthrough_argv assembly. Pure, no spawn.
#   2. fake-engine resolution + exec (no real vsim): a handful of throwaway
#      "engine" scripts that answer `--describe` with JSON and echo a marker
#      when run. Drives the real discover -> resolve -> run_standalone -> exec
#      path end to end. Proves the done-when "selecting a different built <cfg>
#      runs the other binary" deterministically, plus every error path. The
#      fakes ship the SAME standalone template real vsim does ({bin} {elf}), so
#      this exercises the exact argv path.
#   3. real vsim (guarded, best-effort): if a sim_<cfg> is built, invoke it
#      from reset and look for its native "N cycles simulated" line. Standalone
#      from-reset of a hybrid-oriented fixture is environment-dependent, so a
#      timeout or a missing cycle line is a skip, not a failure -- layer 2 is
#      the deterministic proof.
set -uo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
ROOT=$(cd -- "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)
. "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/log.sh"

BIN="$ROOT/build/andesim"
RUNTEST="$ROOT/build/driver/andesim-run-test"

bash "$ROOT/scripts/build_driver.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "build_driver.sh failed"

# 1. unit: resolution branches + passthrough argv
[ -x "$RUNTEST" ] || fail "missing unit-test binary: $RUNTEST"
"$RUNTEST" || fail "run unit tests (resolve_accurate_engine, passthrough_argv) failed"

# --- fixtures: throwaway engine scripts in a scanned dir --------------------
TMP=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT

# mkengine DIR FILE ID KIND MARKER: a fake engine that self-describes as KIND
# and, when run standalone, echoes RAN:MARKER so we can see which binary ran.
mkengine() {
  local f="$1/$2"
  cat >"$f" <<EOF
#!/bin/sh
if [ "\$1" = "--describe" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' '{"id":"$3","type":"vsim","kind":"$4","roles":["standalone","accurate-leg"],"invoke":{"standalone":["{bin}","{elf}"]}}'
else
  echo "RAN:$5 args:\$*"
fi
EOF
  chmod +x "$f"
}

D1="$TMP/one"; D2="$TMP/two"; DF="$TMP/func"; DE="$TMP/empty"
mkdir -p "$D1" "$D2" "$DF" "$DE"
mkengine "$D1" v1 "vsim:v1" cycle-accurate m1
mkengine "$D2" v1 "vsim:v1" cycle-accurate m1
mkengine "$D2" v2 "vsim:v2" cycle-accurate m2
mkengine "$DF" f0 "vsim:f0" functional    fm

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# F9 contract: `run --mode hybrid` -- orchestrate a QEMU1 -> vsim handoff (no
# QEMU2) and print the one-line window-cycle figure for the marker | pc
# triggers. Three layers:
#
#   1. unit (fast, no spawn): the elf-syms boundary resolver, hybrid_trigger
#      (CLI -> Trigger, incl. pc symbol resolution), the trigger->argv mapping
#      (plan-test), and the new CLI flags (cli-test).
#   2. validation error paths via the real binary, all exiting BEFORE any spawn:
#      missing ELF, pc without boundaries, an undefined pc symbol, and an
#      unknown trigger.
#   3. real handoff + golden parity (guarded): run marker/pc through both
#      ./hsim.py (the Python golden) and andesim and assert identical window
#      cycle numbers, plus the new output format. Skipped when the qemu/vsim/
#      plugin artifacts or the golden driver are not built.
#
# pc uses handoff_roundtrip.elf's own markers as the boundaries (_start =
# the enter marker 0x100000, 0x10000c = the exit marker), so pc reproduces marker's
# switch points exactly -- and exercises BOTH symbol and 0x resolution.
set -uo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
ROOT=$(cd -- "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)
. "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/log.sh"

BIN="$ROOT/build/andesim"
ELF="$ROOT/tests/fixtures/handoff_roundtrip.elf"  # asm fixture
CELF="$ROOT/tests/fixtures/rt_c_matmul.elf"       # C fixture (needs shared mmap)
ENG=vsim:ax45mpv_premium  # the engine ./hsim.py resolves by default

bash "$ROOT/scripts/build_driver.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "build_driver.sh failed"

# 1. unit tests (the F9 pure cores)
for t in elf-syms hybrid plan cli; do
  "$ROOT/build/driver/andesim-$t-test" >/dev/null 2>&1 \
    || fail "unit test andesim-$t-test failed"
done
echo "[ok] unit: elf-syms, hybrid_trigger, trigger->argv (plan), CLI flags"

# 2. validation error paths -- real binary, but every case errors before a spawn
# (expect: assert rc + output regex; shared helper from tests/lib/log.sh)
expect 2 'ELF not found'        "$BIN" run --mode hybrid /no/such.elf
expect 2 'engine args go after' "$BIN" run --mode hybrid a.elf b.elf
expect 2 'trigger.*is required' "$BIN" run --mode hybrid "$ELF"
expect 2 'requires --pc-start'  "$BIN" run --mode hybrid --trigger pc "$ELF"
expect 2 'not defined' "$BIN" run --mode hybrid --trigger pc \
  --pc-start nope_xyz --pc-end _start "$ELF"
# pc bounds belong to --trigger pc only: with marker they must be REJECTED, not
# silently dropped (else the run measures the marker window, not the pc window).
expect 2 'applies only to' "$BIN" run --mode hybrid --trigger marker \
  --pc-start _start --pc-end _start --dry-run "$ELF"
expect 2 'unknown trigger'  "$BIN" run --mode hybrid --trigger bogus "$ELF"
expect 2 'requires --kanata' "$BIN" run --mode hybrid --trigger marker \
  --objdump /tmp/o "$ELF"
# a zero-length ROI (--pc-start == --pc-end) measures nothing -- rejected up
# front (fires in hybrid_trigger, before any engine spawn). _start == _start.
expect 2 'same address' "$BIN" run --mode hybrid --trigger pc \
  --pc-start _start --pc-end _start --dry-run "$ELF"
# hybrid owns both legs' command lines, so it takes no post-`--` args: reject
# them (rc=2) instead of silently dropping them as it used to. fast/cycle still
# forward `--` to their single engine.
expect 2 'takes no' "$BIN" run --mode hybrid --trigger marker "$ELF" -- FOO_ARG
echo "[ok] validation: missing ELF, missing --trigger, pc boundaries, bad symbol, unknown trigger, kanata/objdump, empty ROI, no -- args"

# 3. real handoff + golden parity (guarded on built artifacts)
QEMU="$ROOT/build/qemu/qemu-system-riscv64"
SIM="${VSIM_BIN_DIR:-$ROOT/verilator/build}/sim_ax45mpv_premium"
PLUGIN="$ROOT/qemu_plugin/libhybrid_handoff.so"
if [ -x "$QEMU" ] && [ -x "$SIM" ] && [ -f "$PLUGIN" ] && [ -x "$ROOT/hsim.py" ]; then
  # Pull the window/kernel cycle integer from either driver's "] N  (vsim..."
  # line (golden marker/pc say "kernel_cycles", andes says "window_cycles";
  # the number's position is identical).
  cyc() { grep -oE '\] [0-9]+  \(' | grep -oE '[0-9]+' | head -1; }
  check_parity() {  # LABEL GOLDEN_NUM ANDES_NUM
    [ -n "$2" ] || fail "$1: golden produced no cycle number"
    [ -n "$3" ] || fail "$1: andesim produced no cycle number"
    [ "$2" = "$3" ] || fail "$1: cycle mismatch golden=$2 andes=$3"
    echo "[ok] $1 parity: $3 cycles (golden == andesim)"
  }

  # marker -- also assert the new output format (window_cycles + PASS line)
  GO=$(cd "$ROOT" && timeout 180 ./hsim.py run --mode marker "$ELF" 2>&1 | cyc)
  AO=$(timeout 180 "$BIN" run --mode hybrid --trigger marker --engine "$ENG" "$ELF" 2>&1)
  printf '%s\n' "$AO" | grep -Eq '^\[marker window_cycles\] [0-9]+  \(vsim mcycle=' \
    || fail "marker: missing window_cycles line: $AO"
  printf '%s\n' "$AO" | grep -Eq '^PASS: --mode hybrid --trigger marker ' \
    || fail "marker: missing PASS line: $AO"
  # vsim's startup banner is stripped from the relayed vsim-leg output (same as
  # `cycle`), so the result stands alone -- it must not leak onto the user's stream.
  printf '%s\n' "$AO" | grep -q 'Copyright' \
    && fail "marker: vsim startup banner leaked into hybrid output: $AO"
  check_parity marker "$GO" "$(printf '%s\n' "$AO" | cyc)"

  # marker on a C fixture -- the stack/heap + main()'s frame must survive the
  # handoff through the shared mmap (asm fixtures are self-contained; this is
  # the "+ C fixtures" half of the done-when).
  GO=$(cd "$ROOT" && timeout 180 ./hsim.py run --mode marker "$CELF" 2>&1 | cyc)
  AO=$(timeout 180 "$BIN" run --mode hybrid --trigger marker --engine "$ENG" "$CELF" 2>&1 | cyc)
  check_parity marker-c "$GO" "$AO"

  # pc -- symbol start (_start) + 0x end (the exit marker)
  GO=$(cd "$ROOT" && timeout 180 ./hsim.py run --mode pc \
        --pc-start _start --pc-end 0x10000c "$ELF" 2>&1 | cyc)
  AO=$(timeout 180 "$BIN" run --mode hybrid --trigger pc --engine "$ENG" \
        --pc-start _start --pc-end 0x10000c "$ELF" 2>&1 | cyc)
  check_parity pc "$GO" "$AO"

  # kanata ROI trace forwards onto the vsim leg and writes a non-empty file.
  KAN=$(mktemp); rm -f "$KAN"
  timeout 180 "$BIN" run --mode hybrid --trigger marker --engine "$ENG" \
    --kanata "$KAN" "$ELF" >/dev/null 2>&1
  [ -s "$KAN" ] || fail "kanata: trace file empty/missing after marker run"
  echo "[ok] kanata: marker run wrote a non-empty ROI trace ($(wc -l <"$KAN") lines)"
  rm -f "$KAN"
else
  echo "[skip] real handoff parity: need built qemu+vsim+plugin and ./hsim"
fi

# Shared status printers for test scripts. Sourced (not executed).
#
#   fail <msg...>          -> "[FAIL] <msg>" on stderr, exit 1
#   ok   <msg...>          -> "[ok] <msg>" on stdout
#   expect <rc> <re> CMD.. -> run CMD, fail unless it exits <rc> and its
#                             combined output matches the <re> regex
#
# These patterns were duplicated byte-identically across many test scripts.
# Source via:   . "$SCRIPT_DIR/<rel>/lib/log.sh"

fail() { echo "[FAIL] $*" >&2; exit 1; }
ok()   { echo "[ok] $*"; }

expect() {
  local want="$1" re="$2"; shift 2
  local out rc
  out=$("$@" 2>&1 </dev/null); rc=$?
  [ "$rc" -eq "$want" ] || fail "rc=$rc want $want for [$*]: $out"
  printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -Eq "$re" || fail "missing /$re/ for [$*]: $out"
}

# Repo root, derived from this lib's own location (tests/lib/ -> ../..).
_LIB_ROOT=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)

# cfg_val KEY -> the value of KEY in the repo-root config.env ("" if absent).
# A lightweight read so a test runs without a prior `source ./setup.sh`.
cfg_val() { grep -oP "$1=\\K.*" "$_LIB_ROOT/config.env" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '"' | head -1; }

# The external vsim build dir (the sim_* binaries), the way the driver resolves
# it: VSIM_BIN_DIR env, then config.env, then the legacy in-tree build dir.
vsim_bin_dir() {
  if [ -n "${VSIM_BIN_DIR:-}" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$VSIM_BIN_DIR"; return; fi
  local v; v=$(cfg_val VSIM_BIN_DIR)
  [ -n "$v" ] && printf '%s\n' "$v" || printf '%s\n' "$_LIB_ROOT/verilator/build"
}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# F9 contract: `run --mode hybrid --trigger marker` -- orchestrate a QEMU1 ->
# vsim handoff (no QEMU2) and print the one-line window-cycle figure. This is
# the marker slice; pc triggers, --mem-size, and --verify land as the feature
# grows. Layers:
#
#   1. unit (fast, no spawn): hybrid_trigger (CLI -> Trigger) + the trigger->argv
#      mapping and state threading (plan-test).
#   2. validation error paths via the real binary, all exiting BEFORE any spawn:
#      missing ELF, missing --trigger, an unknown trigger, an extra positional.
#   3. --dry-run builds the 2-step [qemu fast-leg -> vsim accurate-leg] plan
#      (a throwaway cycle-accurate engine resolves it; nothing is spawned).
#   4. real handoff (guarded, best-effort): until the shared ABI is pinned to the
#      external vsim the resume ABI-mismatches, so a real run is recorded, not
#      gated.
set -uo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
ROOT=$(cd -- "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)
. "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/log.sh"

BIN="$ROOT/build/andesim"
ELF="$ROOT/tests/fixtures/handoff_roundtrip.elf"  # asm fixture

bash "$ROOT/scripts/build_driver.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "build_driver.sh failed"

# 1. unit tests (the F9 marker cores)
for t in hybrid plan; do
  "$ROOT/build/driver/andesim-$t-test" >/dev/null 2>&1 \
    || fail "unit test andesim-$t-test failed"
done
echo "[ok] unit: hybrid_trigger, trigger->argv (plan)"

# 2. validation error paths -- real binary, every case errors before a spawn
# (expect: assert rc + output regex; shared helper from tests/lib/log.sh)
expect 2 'missing ELF'          "$BIN" run --mode hybrid
expect 2 'engine args go after' "$BIN" run --mode hybrid a.elf b.elf
expect 2 'trigger.*is required' "$BIN" run --mode hybrid "$ELF"
expect 2 'unknown trigger'      "$BIN" run --mode hybrid --trigger bogus "$ELF"
echo "[ok] validation: missing ELF, extra positional, missing --trigger, unknown trigger"

# 3. --dry-run builds a 2-step plan. A throwaway cycle-accurate engine resolves
# the accurate leg without a real vsim build; nothing is spawned.
TMP=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT
cat >"$TMP/v1" <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
if [ "$1" = "--describe" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' '{"id":"vsim:v1","type":"vsim","kind":"cycle-accurate","roles":["accurate-leg"],"invoke":{"accurate-leg":["{bin}","{elf}"]}}'
fi
EOF
chmod +x "$TMP/v1"
out=$(ANDESIM_ENGINES_DIR="$TMP" "$BIN" run --mode hybrid --trigger marker --dry-run "$ELF" 2>&1); rc=$?
[ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || fail "dry-run rc=$rc: $out"
printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -Eq '2-step plan'               || fail "dry-run: no 2-step plan line: $out"
printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -Eq 'fast-leg \[qemu\]'         || fail "dry-run: no fast-leg step: $out"
printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -Eq 'accurate-leg \[vsim:v1\]'  || fail "dry-run: no accurate-leg step: $out"
echo "[ok] --dry-run: 2-step marker plan (qemu fast-leg -> vsim accurate-leg)"

# 4. real handoff (guarded + best-effort). Until the shared ABI is pinned to the
# external vsim, the resume ABI-mismatches, so this is recorded, not gated.
QEMU="$ROOT/build/qemu/qemu-system-riscv64"
SIM=$(ls "$(vsim_bin_dir)"/sim_* 2>/dev/null | head -1)
PLUGIN="$ROOT/qemu_plugin/libhybrid_handoff.so"
if [ -x "$QEMU" ] && [ -n "$SIM" ] && [ -x "$SIM" ] && [ -f "$PLUGIN" ]; then
  ID=$("$SIM" --describe 2>/dev/null | sed -nE 's/.*"id"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"([^"]+)".*/\1/p' | head -1)
  out=$(timeout 180 "$BIN" run --mode hybrid --trigger marker ${ID:+--engine "$ID"} "$ELF" 2>&1); rc=$?
  if printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -Eq '^\[marker window_cycles\] [0-9]+  \(vsim mcycle='; then
    echo "[ok] real marker handoff: window_cycles line produced (rc=$rc)"
  else
    echo "[skip] real marker handoff: no window_cycles line (rc=$rc) -- expected until the shared ABI is pinned to the external vsim"
  fi
else
  echo "[skip] real handoff: need built qemu+vsim+plugin"
fi

ok "F9 run --mode hybrid --trigger marker"
